まず8問で調子を確かめ、次に20問を15分以内で解きます。終わったら Mistake Replay で誤答を解き直し、弱点分析を見て次の練習を選びます。長めに取り組みたい日は、短縮・半分・全体の模擬形式を選べます。

answers.heading: Snapport for a baby's photo: prepare the crop and print sheet, then check the rules
answers.lead: Snapport is a paid download with JPEG, PNG and PDF export included. For a U.S. paper-photo application, choose a 2×2-inch crop and arrange copies on a 4×6 sheet with cut guides. A correct-sized file is not a guarantee that a passport authority will accept the photo.
paras: One purchase includes size templates, face-alignment guides, optional background and adjustment tools, and multiple-copy layouts for 4×6, A4 or Letter. Processing is on the device; there is no per-export purchase, account or subscription. The optional template-update check downloads a public size list and needs a connection.

Start with the receiving authority's current rules for the child's age and application type. Capture an evenly lit photo with the required real background and no other person visible. Keep the original. Choosing a crop and arranging a print sheet is different from changing a face or digitally replacing a background: only use editing that the authority explicitly permits.

For a U.S. paper submission, prepare the required 2×2-inch image, export a 4×6 layout and print at actual size on the required photo paper. A4 and Letter layouts remain available for suitable uses. Where an authority requires an approved digital submission channel, a self-printed sheet is not a substitute.
look: Verify the country, agency, application type and current baby-photo rules before editing.
A background tool being available in the app does not mean it is allowed for an official document.
Do not retouch facial features or rely on a template as proof of acceptance.
Check final print dimensions and the printer's scaling setting.
All export formats belong to the paid Snapport app; Snapport Lite's free limits or watermarks do not apply.
steps: Read the official requirements for this child's application.
Take the photo with the required lighting, pose and real background; preserve the original.
Choose the required size and check face alignment without prohibited alterations.
For a U.S. paper photo, arrange 2×2-inch copies on a 4×6 sheet and export JPEG, PNG or PDF.
Print at actual size where paper submission is allowed, measure the result and check it again before submitting.
rows: 2×2 crop plus 4×6 multiple-copy layout and cut guides
Print settings and the receiving authority still need checking.
Only share or export to a destination you choose.
No acceptance guarantee; some applications require approved digital delivery.
answers.fits: Parents who need a private way to prepare and print a correctly sized photo, and are willing to check the receiving authority's requirements. Snapport supplies editing and output tools, not government approval or a guaranteed result in a fixed number of seconds.
faq: What does one purchase include?
The paid Snapport download includes size and alignment tools, JPEG/PNG/PDF export, and 4×6, A4 and Letter multiple-copy print layouts. There is no subscription or extra charge per export.
Can I digitally replace my baby's background?

Do not assume that you can. Photograph the required background at capture time and follow the receiving authority's rules. Use digital background or touch-up tools for an official document only when that authority explicitly permits the change.
Are all baby-photo rules the same?
No. Age-related exceptions and submission methods vary by authority and application. Check the current official instructions rather than applying another country's rule.
Will the photo definitely be accepted?
No. Snapport is not affiliated with a government and does not guarantee acceptance. Check lighting, pose, permitted editing, dimensions, print quality and submission method.
sources: U.S. Department of State: passport photo requirements

landings.intro: Lumi Mission Planet Pro is een betaalde download: één aankoop bevat de volledige app, zonder proefperiode, in-app aankopen of abonnement. Ouders en kinderen kunnen samen een visuele routine afwerken, met directe feedback en bewaarde voortgang.
landings.what: Wat is Lumi Mission Planet Pro?
description: Lumi Mission Planet Pro is de volledige routine-app voor ouders met kinderen van ongeveer drie tot zeven jaar. Vijf vaste missies behandelen eten, tandenpoetsen, bedtijd, opruimen en schoolvoorbereiding. Je kunt ook onbeperkt eigen missies maken met een eigen pictogram en scène.

Bijvoorbeeld: kies samen de tandenpoetsmissie, laat je kind de kleine stappen aantikken en bekijk na afloop de viering. Anders dan op een losse papieren stickerkaart blijft de voortgang bewaard in het ouderoverzicht, met een zevendaagse kalender en de geschiedenis van elke tik.

De aankoop bevat zes vriendjes, honderd prestatiestickers, overwinningskaarten, instellingen en optionele dagelijkse herinneringen. CSV-export en een back-up helpen ouders de voortgang te bewaren. De ouderfuncties blijven achter de oudercontrole; gegevens en de optionele bijnaam blijven op het apparaat.

Dit is Pro, niet de gratis editie met een latere ontgrendeling. Er zijn geen advertenties, in-app aankopen, abonnementen of accountvereisten. De app ondersteunt een dagelijkse routine, maar biedt geen behandeling of garantie op slaap of gedragsverandering.
faq: Is dit een gratis proefversie?
Nee. Lumi Mission Planet Pro is een betaalde download. De volledige missies, beloningen, instellingen en voortgang zijn bij één aankoop inbegrepen, zonder in-app aankopen of abonnement.
Wat voegt de app toe aan een papieren stickerkaart?

Een kind kan stappen aantikken en krijgt meteen feedback. Ouders kunnen de bewaarde voortgang, zevendaagse kalender en tikgeschiedenis bekijken, eigen missies maken en de gegevens exporteren of back-uppen.
Garandeert de app dat mijn kind beter slaapt?
Nee. De app is een hulpmiddel om samen routines te oefenen, geen slaapbehandeling of garantie op gedragsverandering.

landings.what: WiFi Aid：找出网络问题·诊断 是什么?
description: 先运行整体连接检查，确认是普遍断网还是只有一个目标失败；再使用网站检查，查看指定地址的 DNS、TCP、TLS、HTTP、响应时间与其他独立证据。需要更多样本时使用深度检查，不凭一次超时就下定论。
结果说明最可能的原因及信心程度，检查记录只保存在本机。iPhone、iPad、Widget 和 Apple Watch 的既有功能保留；购买原版后不需要另外解锁、订阅或恢复购买。
WiFi Aid 不读取 iOS 无法提供的 RSSI、附近 Wi-Fi 频道拥堵或其他设备的带宽，不改变路由器设置，也不是 VPN。网络探测需要可用连接，无法完成的检查不能当成确定诊断；不保证修复或提高网速。
本页另有家庭带宽需求表，适合估算多台设备同时使用时的套餐容量。它是免费的网站工具，不是故障诊断结果，也不表示 WiFi Aid 可以免费下载。
faq: 已连接 Wi-Fi，为什么只有一个网站打不开？
先用整体检查建立连接基线，再检查该网站，比较 DNS、TCP、TLS 和 HTTP 等证据。WiFi Aid 只报告最可能的原因和信心，不把一次失败当成确定结论。
可以扫描附近频道、读取其他设备的带宽或控制路由器吗？
不可以。WiFi Aid 不宣称能取得 iOS 无法提供的这些数据，也不控制路由器或充当 VPN。
是免费下载后再解锁吗？
不是。原版 WiFi Aid 是付费下载，首次启动即开放完整功能，没有 App 内购买、订阅或升级。
没有网络也能完成所有检查吗？
不能。网络探测需要连接；无法完成时应查看失败或不确定的证据。已有检查记录保存在本机，可供之后回看。
